Leidos is a technology and engineering company serving government and commercial customers with digital and mission innovations. The Junior Software Developer will support system management for the FAA Terminal Flight Data Manager program by helping integrate, deploy, and maintain air traffic management systems. The role focuses on automation, Linux administration, infrastructure management, and deployment across multiple environments.
